ACCT-001.content: My shipment was picked up by SwiftShip but still shows BOOKED. Why?

**SwiftShip Pickup Confirmation Status:**
- **Known Delay (KI-211):** SwiftShip webhook callbacks can arrive up to **20 minutes late**. A parcel may have physically been collected by the courier while ParcelPilot still displays **BOOKED**.
- **Guidance:** Please verify the carrier API status or allow a 20-minute buffer before concluding that pickup was missed.

*Source: Product Operations Guide Section 2 (KI-211).*

sources.title: Product Operations Guide: SwiftShip Pickup Webhook Lag
sources.text: SwiftShip webhook callbacks can arrive up to 20 minutes late.
